Grey markers = Soft/Hard mix (Hard filters all required; Soft filters need at least one). Large green markers = every enabled filter passes (full AND). Partial Soft matches are never plotted unless pure Soft/OR. Forward P/E is omitted for loss→loss stocks.

25% P→P: low valuation + high growth · N→N: high loss improvement (0–100%, never negative) + closest to profitability · N→P: strong turnaround + future earnings, with a separate low-PSG + low-Future-P/E view.
20% Opportunity diamonds highlight the top-% scores among all passing stocks (strong and weaker). Check Disable to turn highlighting off.
These are display filters: they actually remove other points from the charts, but do not change the screening counts or scoring universe.
Default is a single sector so plots stay apples-to-apples; choose All only when you want the combined set. Options come from the sectors you selected in the GUI.
Profitable→profitable stocks use the P/E-0 band and P/E-1 with SG-1, EG-1 and EG-2.
Loss→loss stocks do not use forward P/E while the company remains loss-making; loss improvement and earnings trajectory are used instead.
Loss→profit stocks use P/E-1 with regime-aware growth metrics.
Profit→loss→profit stocks form a separate experimental universe. P/E-2, forward P/S, two-year EPS CAGR, EPS trough (F1/F0) and recovery (F2/F0) are shown as analysis metrics, not additional pass/fail filters. The standard Sales Growth (SG-1) and Market Cap filters still apply. P/E-2 is current price divided by F2 EPS; it is not a fair-value estimate.
Soft/Hard applies to economically applicable conditions, with full AND (Strong Conviction) producing a smaller, more selective population.
